title: Implement local quote contracts, memory store, country routing, and country greetings
Implement reusable RHF Tomaco controls and Chile form schema and hook
Implement Chile Figma UI, information dialog, responsive styling, and approved assets
Add focused contract, store, validation, country, and UI tests
Capture Playwright CLI desktop and mobile evidence and complete implementation review

summary: Replaced HELLO routing with HOGAR_QUOTE_START, added typed local quote contracts and country-only async greetings, introduced a plain in-memory Zustand quote store, kept shared root chrome, and added shared CO/PE local quote UI. TypeScript and diagnostics pass; inactive Hello files remain for final cleanup.

Added RHF-aware Tomaco Input, CheckBox, InputDate, and Switch controllers; implemented Chile RUT/date/email/mobile/consent/advisor validation and normalization; added onTouched form hook with first-error focus, in-memory payload storage, country-only local quote submission, and approved validation/underage messages. TypeScript and diagnostics pass.

Made the shared Tomaco Header omit logoLink when progress is hidden while preserving the default root link for existing callers; validated focused formatting/lint, TypeScript, production build, SVG assets, and cleanup.

Added mirrored contract, utility, in-memory store, schema, resolver, and browser UI coverage; fixed consent copy interaction while preserving independent privacy-link navigation; replaced the obsolete Hello test with a resolver smoke. Playwright passes 21/21, production build passes, and lint reports 0 errors with 104 pre-existing Homero-script warnings.
